title: Sentinel-free create_object: backend mints id, calls builder
description:
Mark 2026-10-21 (from JMAP-25v7, 'today is the day for all breaking changes'). Every *-server backend trait's create_object currently receives an object with id = "placeholder" (PLACEHOLDER_ID) that the backend MUST replace; chat Message also uses senderMsgId = "placeholder" to mean 'equals assigned id', so a peer/MIMI senderMsgId of literally "placeholder" is rewritten (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs ~L912-938, backend.rs L544-562).
Change: create_object(caller, account_id, create_id, build: F) where F: FnOnce(&Id) -> O + Send; the backend mints the id, calls build(&id), stores the result in the same atomic write, returns (id, obj). Handlers build complete objects inside the closure (chat Message/set: sender_msg_id = id for owner-composed). Remove every PLACEHOLDER_ID const, every sentinel-replacement branch in MemoryBackends/mocks (e.g. mail memory/mod.rs ~L1143-1146), and the 'Sentinel fields the backend MUST replace' docs. Any other create-like trait methods with the same sentinel pattern get the same treatment.
Canonical Templates: jmap-mail-server first, then mirror to all siblings (chat, chat-federation, chat-tasks, calendars, contacts, tasks, filenode, sharing, metadata, graph, scene, vtc, mimi, …; grep PLACEHOLDER_ID and "placeholder"). BREAKING for every backend implementer; CHANGELOG **BREAKING** per crate. Tests: a regression test that a server-originated Message with senderMsgId "placeholder" is stored verbatim (oracle chat-00 §Message senderMsgId text); existing tests updated only where the signature forces it. May be split into several commits (mail first), each with bd: trailer.
